input.prompt: Full-length photograph of a man standing barefoot and facing the camera, arms hanging stiffly, in a stained off-white hospital gown and olive army trousers of an unfamiliar country. His posture is too still, unsettling. Lit by warm lamp light from the front. Shot against a plain, flat, light-grey seamless studio backdrop: nothing else in the frame, no floor line, no props, the whole figure fully inside the frame with a margin around it.
